# SIMDIS corpus provenance

This corpus is intentionally split by confidence level.

## `public_seed/asi`

Synthetic files created from command names and argument order confirmed in the public `ASIViewer.cpp` parser in the SIMDIS SDK.

## `public_seed/gog`

Synthetic files created from shape names and serializer fields confirmed in the public SIMDIS SDK GOG parser/shape model.

## `inferred/discn`

Candidate `.discn` content. The public SDK groups `.discn` with ASI-compatible file patterns, but the exact scenario initialization grammar needs validation against an installed SIMDIS distribution.

## `needs_official_samples/fct`

`.fct` is listed as SIMDIS Binary. No fake `.fct` is included.

## `needs_official_samples/svml`

`.svml` is listed as SIMDIS 10 view format. No fake `.svml` is included.
